INSURANCE REGULATORY AND inde DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA 

18. Shri Deepak Yohannan,CEO,MIC Insurance WA Pvt Ltd- Member 

19. Shri Deependra Kumar Yadav, Pricipal officer, SBI,HO-Member 

20. Principal officer, WC Wallet Advisory IMF- Member 

21. Smt. J.Meena Kumari, CGM (Life), IRDAI – Member 

22. Smt. Yegna Priya Bharat, CGM (Health), IRDAI - Member 

23. Shri. D.V.S. Ramesh, CGM (Non-Life), IRDAI- Member 

24. Smt. J.Anita, GM (Intermediaries), IRDAI- Member Convener 

The committee shall have the following terms of reference: 

1. To develop and suggest constitution and operation of a preferably, women centric distribution channel to focus on reaching untapped/rural areas - Bima Vahak - and recommend regulatory framework therefor 

2. To develop and suggest affordable, accessible and comprehensive cover for rural population, on benefit based / parametric structure - Bima Vistaar - and recommend regulatory framework therefor 

3. To explore and recommend on how to bring about synergies in the working and operations of Bima Vahak, Bima Vistaar and the digital platform - Bima Sugam 

The Committee may meet as often as needed and may submit its report to Chairman, IRDAI within a period of 21 days from the date of this order. 

This is issued with the approval of Competent Authority.
